hints.title: Sentinel Head for Merging
hints.text: How can you build a new sorted sequence by comparing the current heads without creating duplicate nodes?

hints.title: Dummy Sentinel Elimination of Edge Cases
hints.text: A sentinel dummy node avoids conditional logic for setting the initial head of the merged sequence.

hints.title: Pointer Rewiring Procedure
hints.text: Create a dummy node and a tail pointer. While both lists are non-empty, attach the node with the smaller value to tail.next and advance that list. After the loop, append whichever list has remaining nodes. Return dummy.next.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: In-place pointer rewiring traversing each node at most once.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Copying elements into an array, sorting them, and re-linking takes O((N + M) log(N + M)) time and O(N + M) space.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: In-place pointer re-wiring takes O(N + M) time and O(1) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use of a dummy head node to simplify pointer manipulation, attaching remaining nodes in O(1) after one list exhausts, and zero node allocations.
